name: Multi-Segment Envelope Presets
author: Freek van Gool
description: Drawn curves for Multi-Segment Envelope: build-ups and drops, filter sweeps, steps, breathing swells, gates and ratchets, pumps and plucks, slow generative drift, and a few genre rhythms. Curves run from -1 to +1 and the depth per target is set in the assignment list; most unipolar curves rest at 0, so set the target knob to its resting value and use a positive depth, or a negative depth to invert.
